uiLanguage.title: Language
uiLanguage.draftNote: Draft translations were made by machine and are still being checked. Some words may be wrong.
uiLanguage.help: Choose the language LangQuest speaks to you in.

peer.name: Peer Review
peer.description: Another translator listens for accuracy and natural speech.

bt.name: Back Translation
bt.description: A bilingual speaker records the passage back into English, in their own words. It's new content, not a verdict: the Consultant Check uses it to compare meaning.

community.name: Community Check
community.description: Play it for people in the community and capture what they understood.

consultant.name: Consultant Check
consultant.description: A consultant checks meaning against the source, verse by verse.

final.name: Final Approval
final.description: Sign-off that the passage is ready to share.

retell.name: Retell Check
retell.description: A listener retells the passage in their own words.

local.name: Local Check
local.description: Local listeners hear the polished recording and say whether it sounds natural and acceptable.

errors.nothingChanged: Nothing changed since the last version.
errors.pickVersionHeard: Pick the version that was heard.
errors.onlyPublishedReviewed: Only a published version can be reviewed.
errors.onlyPublishedBackTranslated: Only a published version can be back-translated.
errors.teamOrPerson: Ask a team or a person, not both.
errors.requestNamesKind: A review request names its kind.
errors.noteNeedsContent: A note needs words, a voice note or a photo.
errors.stepNeedsKind: Every step needs a kind of review.
errors.versionOrReview: Name the version or the review, not both.

allRightsReserved.name: All rights reserved
allRightsReserved.means: Only your members can see and use your work. Nobody else may copy or share it.

ccByNcNd.name: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
ccByNcNd.means: Anyone may see and pass on your work as it is, if they credit you. They may not change it or sell it.

ccByNcSa.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
ccByNcSa.short: Share and adapt, not for sale
ccByNcSa.means: Anyone may see, pass on and adapt your work, if they credit you and share what they make the same way. They may not sell it.

ccBySa.name: CC BY-SA 4.0
ccBySa.means: Anyone may use, adapt and even sell your work, if they credit you and share what they make the same way.

ccBy.name: CC BY 4.0
ccBy.means: Anyone may use, adapt and sell your work for any purpose, as long as they credit you.

cc0.name: CC0 (public domain)
cc0.means: You give up your rights. Anyone may use your work for anything, without asking or crediting you.
